label: D1 after an a1 choice that went rare (S2) and was unrewarded, mid/late episode
explanation: Fires only at D1, never at GO or D2. It is strongest when the previous trial was a1 -> S2 (rare) with no reward, the rare-unrewarded case where a model-based agent should repeat a1. All variables are observed at D1 (the previous trial and its outcome). The core predicate without the time limit gives F1 0.52 and mass recall 0.77, and its coverage rises with activation quartile (0.64 to 0.82). Activity also depends on episode time: it is absent before trial ~20, peaks around trials 50-89 and almost disappears in trials 90-99, so the ep_trial window raises dev F1 to 0.64. Almost all mass (96%) is on D1 steps with prev_reward == 0 where the policy leans moderately toward a1 (choice logit 2.8 to 8). It is nearly silent after rewarded trials, after common transitions, and after a2 choices. Misses: weak activations at the first D1 of a window (where the previous trial is unknown) and after other unrewarded a1 trials. False positives: rare-unrewarded a1 trials where the feature stays off, often when the trial before was rewarded.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
